purpose: Leg-level reconstruction of multi-position campaign behaviour from posted evidence, so follower simulations become leg-resolved instead of assumption-bound. Analytic only.
explicitly_excluded_fields: lot size / volume as a number (widget volumes are descriptive evidence text or hashed, never sizing inputs)
enforcement: ai_review fail-closed validator + extended forbidden-token guard apply to every leg record (TRADE_READY/EXECUTE/ORDER/LOT_SIZE/BROKER_ROUTE/ACCOUNT_ID/RISK_SIZE/COPY_TRADE/NANO/LIVE/DEMO_EXECUTE unwritable as keys/labels)

leg_record_fields.campaign_id: string — groups setups that are re-entries of one idea (e.g. JUN15-BUY-CAMPAIGN)
leg_record_fields.leg_type: INITIAL_ENTRY | ADDITIONAL_ENTRY | RE_ENTRY | PARTIAL_EXIT | CLOSE_WORST | HOLD_BEST | SL_TO_ENTRY | FINAL_CLOSE | RUNNER
leg_record_fields.entry_zone_or_price_if_known: string | null (verbatim from post/widget; null when never posted)
leg_record_fields.pips_deterministically_supported_if_any: number | null (from the OHLC matcher only)

audit_findings.model_A: single-entry/multi-exit abstraction — multiple entries, close-worst/hold-best leg ops, intra-setup re-entries NOT modelled
audit_findings.widget_irony: where widgets exist (J11, J24), HIS book ran one unchanged position while instructions described multi-leg follower choreography — lane-1 largely leg-insensitive; leg problem lives in follower lanes

high_sensitivity_cases.S3: far edge 4083 verifiably filled 12:47Z; hold-best leg plausibly survived the retrace that scratched near-edge -> ~+300-500p on that leg (ESTIMATE, computable)

moderate.J10: explicitly 3-point layered with NO posted prices — loss robust, magnitude assumption-based

audit_findings.materiality_estimate: leg-resolved Model B ~ +10-16p/trade (from +1.4) — narrows the A/B band from below, does not close it; instruction timing (8C) remains the binding uncertainty

remains_assumption_based: unposted layered entry prices (e.g. J10's three points)
which legs a follower holds at close-worst
per-leg BE placement (his stops provably differ from instructions)
forward_capture_requirements_cycle_002: every entry message -> INITIAL_ENTRY/ADDITIONAL_ENTRY/RE_ENTRY leg event (message id + exact ts)
every close-worst / hold-best instruction -> CLOSE_WORST / HOLD_BEST events with leg linkage where statable
every SL-to-entry instruction -> SL_TO_ENTRY event (feeds 8C scratch_trigger computation)
every final-close / result claim -> FINAL_CLOSE event with pips_claimed
widget screenshots -> SCREENSHOT_WIDGET evidence rows (prices verbatim, volumes as descriptive text/hash only)
